notes.content: This agreement includes courses that may be completed prior to transfer, and satisfy major requirements. All required courses for the major must be completed with a grade of C- or better (equivalent for EDUC 101 must be completed with a B- or better for acceptance to the School of Education). Students must complete 18 units required for the major in residence at CUI. Agreement does not include all courses required in the major at CUI. Please refer to the CUI Catalog for a complete list of majors and degree requirements: http://catalog.cui.edu/ Also view Transfer Policies/Requirements on the website at: https://www.cui.edu/studentlife/registrar/undergraduate-transfer-credits **Courses listed are approved to satisfy area requirements IN THIS MAJOR ONLY !! It is not a guaranteed course-for-course equivalent.** Students are encouraged to review GE course options to identify courses that may apply to both GE and major prerequisites/requirements. **BIO 101, CENG 203 and CHST 203 can only have approved substitutions as noted if the student transfers in 30+ units prior to the first term of attendance. Students with 29 or fewer transfer units must take CBIO 101, CENG 203 and CHST 203 at CUI.
